title: Choose design directions
responsibility: Returns distinct predefined directions for visual design options in their established order.

inputs.name: designDirections.count
inputs.description: The number of directions to take from the predefined list of ten. Callers normally supply a validated count from 1 to 10; this helper applies array slicing without validating it.

outputs.name: designDirections
outputs.description: A new list beginning with the most direct reading of the proposal, followed by the selected density, spacing, action-first, split-screen, cards, list, bold, calm and narrow-screen directions. Counts above ten return at most ten.
